blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
World-action models (WAMs) jointly predict how a scene will evolve and how an agent should act, however joint generation alone does not necessarily impose a shared geometric constraint on these predictions.
We present PhysWAM , a unified world-action model for autonomous driving that co-denoises multiview video, metric depth, and ego motion within a single flow-matching transformer.
To ground world and action generation in measured scene geometry, we introduce Coupled Point Projection (CPP) that unprojects the generated depth into 3D points, transforms them using the generated SE ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{SE}(3) ego motion, and minimizes their distance to LiDAR points transformed using the recorded ego motion.
This geometric constraint promotes physical consistency with the measured scene by jointly supervising generated depth and motion alongside their standard flow-matching objectives.
At inference, trajectory selection relies only on a simple label-free consensus rule, with no learned scorer or simulator feedback.
We evaluate PhysWAM across NAVSIM v1 and v2 planning, zero-shot closed-loop transfer, and future video and metric-depth prediction.
Despite PhysWAM ’s simple selection procedure, it achieves strong planning performance and transfers zero-shot to unseen driving environments.
It also generates accurate metric depth and temporally coherent video, with CPP improving both planning and depth prediction.
Together, these results demonstrate that the geometric relationship between scene depth and ego motion provides a direct way to couple world and action generation within a simple unified model.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
A driving decision changes both how the ego vehicle moves and what it observes along its route.
A planned trajectory and the scene observed along it therefore describe the same future from different perspectives.
End-to-end driving systems learn such decisions directly from sensor observations [ Prakash et al., 2021 ; Hu et al., 2023b ; Jiang et al., 2023 ; Liao et al., 2025 ] , driving world models generate future scenes [ Wang et al., 2024c ; Hu et al., 2023a ; Wang et al., 2024d ; Gao et al., 2024b ] , increasingly across views and with geometric conditioning [ Gao et al., 2024a ; Li et al., 2025a ] , and recent world-action models predict future observations and ego motion together [ Zhang et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2026b ; Shi et al., 2026 ] .
Joint generation alone, however, does not impose a shared geometric constraint on these predictions.
blocks.zh:
驾驶决定既改变了自负车的行驶方式,也改变了它沿途观察到的情况。
因此,计划轨迹和沿着轨迹观察到的场景从不同角度描述了同样的未来。
端对端驱动系统直接从传感器观测中学习这种决定[ Prakash等人,2021年;Hu等人,2023年b;Jiang等人,2023年;Liao等人,2025年],驱动世界模型生成未来场景[Wang等人,2024年c;Hu等人,2023年a;Wang等人,2024年d;Gao等人,2024年b]],越来越多的观点和几何条件[Gao等人,2024年a;Li等人,2025年a],最近的世界行动模型预测未来观测和自我运动在一起[Zhang等人,2024年b], 2025b;刘等人,2026b;史等人,2026].
然而,单是联合生成并不对这些预测造成共同的几何限制。

blocks.en:
Existing approaches connect scene prediction and planning by using predicted images or features to shape a policy’s representation [ Li et al., 2025c ; Li et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026c ; Zhao et al., 2026b ] , by exposing present or predicted geometry to the planner [ Zuo et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Lu et al., 2026 ] , by adding depth and other scene targets alongside video and action learning [ Zhou et al., 2026a ; Sheng et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ] , or by supervising the generated video with geometry [ Fu et al., 2026 ] .
These approaches establish the value of scene prediction for driving.
The geometric relationship between scene depth and ego motion also lets us supervise the scene they describe together, using measured geometry as a common reference.
This motivates a shared objective that depends on both generated depth and motion, complementing their individual prediction losses.
Table 17 in App. E summarizes how representative works connect future prediction to planning.
This naturally motivates the question: how can we use the geometric relationship between scene depth and ego motion to couple world and action generation?

blocks.en:
Metric depth offers a direct way to express this relationship: feed-forward reconstruction methods recover scene structure and camera geometry from images [ Wang et al., 2024b ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Keetha et al., 2026 ] , and dynamic reconstruction methods recover geometry and motion over time from video [ Zhang et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2026a ] .
We draw on this geometric perspective to connect world and action generation.
Generated depth can be unprojected into 3D and transformed using generated ego motion into a shared reference frame.
LiDAR observations transformed using recorded motion provide the measured scene geometry in that same frame.
Errors in depth, motion, or both can distort or displace the generated scene relative to this reference.
We promote physical consistency with the measured scene by penalizing this discrepancy through a single geometric loss that supervises both predictions.
Figure 1 visualizes this comparison for generated futures with small and large geometric discrepancies.

blocks.en:
We introduce PhysWAM , a unified world-action model that co-denoises multiview video, metric depth, and ego motion within a single transformer.
Building on the Cosmos family of pretrained world models [ Agarwal et al., 2025 ; Agarwal et al., 2026 ] , we represent the three modalities in a shared sequence trained with flow matching [ Lipman et al., 2022 ] .
Conditioned on current multiview images, camera calibration, driving context, and ego history, the model jointly generates future video, metric depth maps, and an ego trajectory through iterative denoising.
Bidirectional attention allows all three modalities to exchange information throughout this process.

我们引入了PhysWAM, 一个统一的世界行动模型, 共同将多景视频, 度量深度, 和自我运动 在一个单一的变压器。
基于预先训练过的世界模型的宇宙家族[Agarwal等人,2025年;Agarwal等人,2026年],我们代表了三种模式,它们是一个经过流动匹配培训的共同序列[Lipman等人,2022年]。
该模型以当前多视图图像、相机校准、驱动背景和自我历史为条件,通过迭代调试,共同生成未来的视频、度量深度图和自我轨迹。
双向关注使所有三种模式都能在整个过程中交流信息。

blocks.en:
To explicitly couple the depth and ego motion generated by this model, we introduce Coupled Point Projection (CPP).
CPP unprojects generated depth into 3D and transforms the resulting points using generated SE ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{SE}(3) ego motion.
Corresponding LiDAR observations transformed using recorded motion provide the reference in the same coordinate frame.
CPP penalizes distances between the generated and measured geometry, so errors in depth, motion, or both contribute to the same loss.
The supervision of each prediction therefore depends on the other, complementing their individual flow-matching objectives.
This promotes physical consistency with the measured scene through the geometric relationship between generated depth and ego motion. We also keep inference simple.
Several driving systems use learned scorers to evaluate candidate trajectories, either directly or from predicted future states [ Li et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2025d ; Zhong et al., 2026 ] .
For each input scene, PhysWAM instead samples multiple trajectories and selects a representative one using only their pairwise distances.
This parameter-free consensus rule requires no labels, learned scorer, or simulator feedback.

blocks.en:
We evaluate PhysWAM both as a driving policy and through the quality of its generated future world.
Planning experiments cover NAVSIM v1 and v2, including navtest and two-stage pseudo-simulation [ Dauner et al., 2024 ; Cao et al., 2025 ] .
Motivated by recent evidence of cross-domain driving transfer [ Liu et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2026b ] , we also evaluate zero-shot closed-loop driving in HUGSIM [ Zhou et al., 2025 ] , without target-domain fine-tuning.
Beyond planning, we assess future-video quality and metric-depth accuracy.
Despite its simple trajectory selection, PhysWAM achieves strong planning compared to leading methods and transfers zero-shot across driving environments.
It also generates accurate metric depth and temporally coherent video.
CPP improves both planning and depth prediction, while consensus selection improves planning over using a single generated trajectory for each input scene.
Together, these results demonstrate the value of coupling generated depth and ego motion through a shared geometric objective.

这些结果共同显示了结合通过共同的几何目标产生的深度和自我运动的价值。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold. Unified world-action generation: we develop a shared flow-matching formulation that co-denoises multiview video, metric depth, and ego motion within one model. Physical consistency through geometric coupling: we introduce Coupled Point Projection (CPP), a geometric objective that jointly supervises generated depth and ego motion against measured scene geometry, complementing their individual prediction objectives. Broad evaluation with simple inference: we demonstrate strong planning and zero-shot closed-loop transfer with label-free trajectory selection, alongside accurate metric depth and temporally coherent video.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Generative driving world models. Driving world models generate controllable future video [ Wang et al., 2024c ; Hu et al., 2023a ; Gao et al., 2024b ] , across cameras in GAIA-2 [ Russell et al., 2025 ] , and with LiDAR, occupancy, depth or semantics added to the generated future in MUVO, OccWorld and OmniNWM [ Bogdoll et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025a ] . PhysWAM generates multiview video and metric depth together with ego motion in one flow-matching model.
blocks.zh: 基因驱动世界模型. 驱动世界模型生成可控的未来视频[Wang等人,2024c;Hu等人,2023a;Gao等人,2024b],横跨GAIA-2 [Russell等人,2025年]的相机,与LiDAR一起,在MUVO,OccWorld和OmniNWM生成的未来中添加了占用,深度或语义[Bogdol等人,2025年;郑等人,2024年;李等人,2025a]. PhysWAM在一个流配模型中生成多视图视频和度量深度与自我运动.

blocks.en: World-action models and planning. Future prediction improves policies as an auxiliary objective [ Li et al., 2025c ; Zhao et al., 2026b ] and through joint video–action generation [ Zhang et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2026b ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2026 ] ; predicted futures also serve learned trajectory evaluation, refinement and safety-aware exploration [ Zheng et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Sheng et al., 2026 ] . PhysWAM follows joint generation but selects among samples with a parameter-free consensus rule, without a learned scorer or simulator feedback.
blocks.zh: 世界行动模式与规划. 未来预测将改进政策,将其作为一个辅助目标[Li等人,2025c;Zhao等人,2026b],并通过联合视频-行动生成[Zhang等人,2025b;Liu等人,2025b]。 2026b; 朱等人, 2025; 叶等人, 2026]; 预测未来也为学习的轨迹评价,完善和安全意识探索服务 [郑等人, 2025; 杨等人, 2026; 刘等人, 2026a; 沈等人, 2026]. PhysWAM遵循联合生成,但在样本中选择无参数共识规则,没有学习的计分器或模拟反馈.

blocks.en: Geometry in world and action generation. Geometry enters generative driving models as a conditioning signal along supplied trajectories [ Chen et al., 2025a ; Yaokun et al., 2026 ] , as a generated output [ Liang et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026a ] , as a planning representation [ Zhang et al., 2026b ; Lu et al., 2026 ] , or as a training target for the video features [ Wu et al., 2026 ; Fu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026a ] , a line that goes back to learning depth and camera motion from view synthesis [ Zhou et al., 2017 ] . PhysWAM adds generated ego motion to the geometric objective: CPP unprojects the generated depth, carries it with the generated motion, and compares it with LiDAR under the recorded motion in one frame, supervising both outputs alongside their flow-matching objectives (App. E discusses these works in more detail).

PhysWAM为几何目标增加了生成的自我运动:CPP将生成的深度放出,与生成的动作一起携带,并在一个框架下与LiDAR进行对比,同时监督两种输出及其流量匹配目标(App. E更详细地讨论了这些工作)。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
PhysWAM combines joint video, depth, and motion generation with a geometric objective that supervises the depth–motion pair against measured scene structure (Fig. 2 ).
We first define the generation problem and its representation, then introduce CPP, supporting trajectory constraints, and the training and inference procedures.

我们首先界定生成问题及其代表性,然后引入CPP,支持轨迹限制,以及培训和推论程序.

blocks.en:
Model architecture. We adapt the Cosmos 3 Mixture-of-Transformers architecture [ Agarwal et al., 2026 ; Liang et al., 2024 ] , based on Qwen3-VL [ Bai et al., 2025 ] .
Its understanding and generation pathways have separate parameters with shared attention: text attends causally within the text context, while visual and action tokens attend to text and one another bidirectionally.
We fine-tune the generation pathway, its projections, and embeddings, keeping the text pathway and video VAE fixed.
We extend this architecture to jointly denoise multiview video, depth, and motion without a separate depth denoiser.

blocks.en:
Depth and ego motion jointly determine how the generated scene is placed in 3D.
CPP uses this relationship to supervise both predictions against measured scene geometry: it transforms generated depth with generated motion, then compares the result with LiDAR transformed using recorded motion.
This gives a shared metric objective without sampling a full future during training.
blocks.zh:
深度和自我运动共同决定生成的场景如何放置在3D中.
CPP利用这种关系来对照测量的场景几何来监督两种预测:它用生成的运动来转化生成的深度,然后用记录的运动来比较结果与LiDAR转换.
这使得在培训期间有一个共同的衡量目标,而不对未来进行全面取样。

blocks.en:
Efficient metric-depth estimation. Applying geometric supervision through the full video VAE decoder would require decoding dense depth at every training update.
Instead, a lightweight convolutional depth head Π ϕ \Pi_{\phi} maps the estimated clean depth latents 𝐱 ^ v , D \widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{v,D} directly to metric depth on the VAE grid.
It applies three spatial convolutions with GELU activations to each latent frame and produces one log-depth value per cell without changing spatial resolution.
Writing ℓ min = log ⁡ ( 1 + d min ) \ell_{\min}=\log(1+d_{\min}) and ℓ max = log ⁡ ( 1 + d max ) \ell_{\max}=\log(1+d_{\max}) for the fixed depth-encoding bounds, d ^ j v ​ ( u ) = exp ⁡ ( clip ⁡ ( [ Π ϕ ​ ( 𝐱 ^ v , D ) ] j ​ ( u ) , ℓ min , ℓ max ) ) − 1 \widehat{d}_{j}^{v}(u)=\exp(\operatorname{clip}([\Pi_{\phi}(\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{v,D})]_{j}(u),\ell_{\min},\ell_{\max}))-1 , where u u indexes a VAE latent grid cell, not a transformer patch, and d ^ j v ​ ( u ) \widehat{d}_{j}^{v}(u) is optical-axis depth in metres.

blocks.en: We compare against three families: end-to-end planners trained on NAVSIM, including the strongest recent one, BeyondDrive [ Wang et al., 2026b ] ; vision–language–action models [ Zhou et al., 2026b ; Xiong et al., 2026 ] ; and world-action models that plan through a generative model of the scene [ Zhang et al., 2025b ; Zhao et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026 ; Zuo et al., 2026b ; Zhou et al., 2026a ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Fu et al., 2026 ; Hong et al., 2026 ] . PhysWAM is trained by supervised fine-tuning with the CPP and hinge terms alone; several of the strongest compared methods add reinforcement learning after imitation [ Zhou et al., 2026b ; Xiong et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ] or a trajectory scorer distilled from the simulator [ Li et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2026 ] .

blocks.en: 4.2 Ablations
blocks.zh: 4.2 违约

blocks.en:
We study the design of PhysWAM in two settings.
CPP is ablated at the full recipe above by training the same model without the CPP term, reported as “without CPP” in Tables 1 – 2 .
The objective terms and the views are ablated in a lighter setting: rank-128 LoRA adapters [ Hu et al., 2021 ] on the generation pathway, trained for 16,000 updates, with all other differences from the full recipe listed in Table 10 .
Each row of this setting differs from the full objective only in terms or views it names.
blocks.zh:
我们在两个场合研究PhysWAM的设计.
CPP通过在不使用CPP术语的情况下培训同一模型,在表1-2中报告为“没有CPP”。
客观术语和观点在较轻的环境下有所减弱:级别-128 LoRA适配器 [ Hu et al., 2021) 关于生成路径,
此设置的每行都与全部目标不同,只用它命名或查看它.

blocks.en:
Coupled point projection. CPP speeds up learning to plan: after 4,000 updates, the model without CPP scores 57.0 PDMS against 80.3, leaves the drivable area in a third of the scenes rather than a tenth, and has more than three times the heading error (Table 3 a, top).
The gap narrows with training but does not close: the final model without CPP scores 89.6 against 91.4 PDMS on navtest , 36.2 against 38.1 EPDMS on navhard , and 33.4 against 35.5 HD-Score on HUGSIM (Table 3 a, bottom), below the best prior method on each (ReCogDrive, 90.8; GeoWAM, 36.6; BeyondDrive, 34.8).
It also generates worse depth and motion: its per-pixel depth error against LiDAR is 8–15% higher across views and horizons (AbsRel 0.193 against 0.175 in the front view at +2 s), and fewer of its sampled futures end in a pose that agrees with the recorded one (70.9% against 81.4%; Table 13 ).
blocks.zh:
双点投影 CPP加速学习计划:4000更新后,没有CPP的模型得分57.0 PDMS对80.3,将可驾驶区域留在三分之一的场景而不是十分之一,并且有超过3倍的标题错误(表3 a,最高).
差距随着培训而缩小,但并不接近:没有CPP的最终模型在导航测试上得分89.6比91.4PDMS,在导航测试上得分36.2比38.1EPDMS,在HUGSIM上得分33.4比35.5HD-Score(表3a,底部),低于每种最佳的前置方法(ReCogDrive,90.8;GeoWAM,36.6;BeyondDrive,34.8)。
它还产生更糟糕的深度和运动:其相对于LiDAR的每像素深度误差在对视和视野上高出8–15%(AbsRel 0.193对前视值为+2s的0.175),并且其样本期货以与记录的相同(70.9%对81.4%;表13)的姿势结束的更少.

blocks.en:
Objective terms. Under the LoRA setting, the hinges add 1.5 PDMS to flow matching, CPP adds 2.1, and both together add 2.5 (Table 3 b).
CPP is the larger contribution, and the hinges still add 0.4 on top of it.
Flow matching supervises each modality in its native representation and the hinges supervise waypoint feasibility; CPP adds a shared metric-space residual whose gradients depend jointly on the generated depth and motion, so each branch is trained to agree with the other’s current prediction as well as with the measurement (App. A.2 ).
The ablation establishes the benefit of this added objective; distinguishing the effect of the coupling from that of metric-space supervision of each branch requires a matched decoupled comparison.
blocks.zh:
客观条件。 在LORA设置下,链条增加了1.5PDMS来匹配流量,CPP增加了2.1,两者都加2.5(表3b).
CPP是更大的贡献,链条仍然在它上面增加了0.4.
流量匹配在其本土代表中监督每一种模式,而链条则监督路标的可行性;CPP增加了一个共享的公尺空间残基,其梯度共同取决于生成的深度和运动,因此每个分支都经过培训同意对方目前的预测和测量(App.A.2)。
宽减确定了这一附加目标的好处;区分结合效应与每个分支的计量空间监督效应需要相应的脱钩比较。

blocks.en:
Multi-view generation. Observing and generating all three views instead of the front view alone raises PDMS by 1.1 overall (Table 3 d).
The gain is 0.3 on straight roads and 2.3–2.7 on turns, where the drivable boundary and crossing traffic lie in the side views that the single-view model neither observes nor generates. Without generated depth, and hence without CPP on the side-view cells, the three views add only 0.4 over the front view alone (App. C.4 ), so most of the gain arrives via CPP.
blocks.zh:
多视一代. 观察和生成所有三种观点,而不仅仅是前视图,使PDMS整体提高了1.1(表3d)。
收益为直路0.3和转弯2.3–2.7,其中可驾驶的边界和穿越交通位于单视模型既不观察也不生成的侧面观点. 没有产生深度,因此在侧视图单元格上没有CPP,这三种观点仅在前视图上加0.4(App. C.4),所以大部分收益通过CPP到达.

blocks.en:
Hinge schedule. Both hinges are one-sided and vanish on every plan that keeps its margins, so late in training the balancing of Sec. 3.4 would concentrate their fixed gradient fraction on few plans that still violate them; we therefore anneal both hinges to zero by the middle of training.
CPP penalizes deviation in either direction on every LiDAR-supported cell, so it does not vanish once plans are safe, and removing it from update 20,000 onward costs 1.2 HD-Score on HUGSIM (App. C.4 ).
blocks.zh:
兴化时刻表. 这两根链条都是片面的,在保持其边际的每一个计划上都消失了,因此在训练Sec的平衡方面很晚。 3.4会把固定的梯度部分集中在几个仍然违反它们的计划上;因此,我们两个在训练中间都以零为依归。
CPP惩罚每个LiDAR支持的单元格的任意方向偏差,因此不会在计划安全后消失,从更新的20,000后成本中去掉HUGSIM上的1.2HD-Score(App. C.4 ).

blocks.en: Qualitative examples. Figure 3 shows both ablations on individual scenes: without CPP the plan drives into a parked van that the full model stops short of, and without the side views the plan cuts a left turn into an oncoming car that only the left camera shows at t = 0 t=0 .
blocks.zh: 定性譬喻. 图3显示了单个场景上的两处擦伤:没有CPP,计划开进一辆停靠的货车,而整个车型都停了下来,没有旁观者,计划将左转切成一辆只有左相机显示在t=0 t=0的即将到来的车.

blocks.en: 4.3 World-Model Quality
blocks.zh: 4.3 世界模式质量

blocks.en:
Metric depth. Scored against the LiDAR sweep of the same future frame and camera without scale alignment, front-view depth reaches AbsRel 0.175 at +2 s and 0.232 at +4 s (Table 3 c), and 0.144 and 0.194 on the cells that CPP supervises.
These values are below the future-depth results reported on nuScenes, a different dataset and rig (GeoWAM [ Lu et al., 2026 ] , 0.245 and 0.297; Epona [ Zhang et al., 2025b ] with a DVGT [ Zuo et al., 2026a ] head, 0.263 and 0.310; VGGT-World [ Sun et al., 2026b ] , 0.329 and 0.357; Cosmos 3 [ Agarwal et al., 2026 ] + DVGT, 0.376 and 0.422); the side views and the error structure are in App. C.5 .
blocks.zh:
度量深处. 与LiDAR扫射相同的未来帧和相机而无尺度对齐,前视深度在+2s和+4s(表3c)分别达到AbsRel0.175和0.232,在CPP监督的单元格上达到0.144和0.194.
这些数值低于所报告的关于不同数据集和钻机nuScens的未来深入结果(GeoWAM[Lu等人,2026],0.245和0.297;Epona[ Zhang等人,2025b],头部为DVGT[Zuo等人,2026a];VGGT-World[Sun等人,2026b],0.329和0.357;宇宙3[Agarwal等人,2026]+DVGT,0.376和0.422];侧视图和误差结构载于App.C.5.

blocks.en:
Video. The generated front video reaches FVD-9 111.3 against a recorded-versus-recorded floor of 91.5 at 600 clips per side, and 42.2 over all 1,200 clips (Table 14 ); reported NAVSIM values range from 142.6 (DrivingGPT [ Chen et al., 2025b ] ) to 32.7 (CoWorld-VLA [ Huang et al., 2026 ] ) under their own protocols.
The generated video and depth also agree with the generated motion: the camera yaw recovered from the video deviates from it by a median of 0.80 ∘ 0.80^{\circ} over 4 s against a 0.29 ∘ 0.29^{\circ} floor on recorded clips, and the front and side depths agree to within 1.5 × \times the LiDAR floor (App. C.5 ).
5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented PhysWAM , a world-action model that denoises multi-view video, metric depth and ego motion in one generator and couples the generated depth and motion through Coupled Point Projection (CPP), one loss on projected LiDAR geometry in metric space, alongside two geometric hinge losses and output-gradient balancing.
The model plans strongly on NAVSIM, transfers zero-shot to closed-loop driving and generates accurate future depth. Removing CPP degrades both planning and depth performance.
A self-supervised form of the coupling would let the model scale to driving data without LiDAR or dense labels, and consistency on rollouts away from the strictly recorded trajectory. Additionally, backbones and scales beyond the one studied here, are the relevant directions we find promising to explore (limitations in App. D ).
blocks.zh:
PhysWAM是一个世界行动模型, 将多视图视频、量子深度和自负运动, 放在一个发电机和夫妇身上,
模型在NAVSIM上有强烈的计划,将零射转至闭路驾驶,并产生准确的未来深度. 删除CPP既会降低规划和深度性能.
组合的自我监督形式将使模型尺度在没有LiDAR或稠密的标签的情况下驱动数据,并使推出时的一致性脱离严格记录的轨迹。 此外,在本文所研究的支柱和尺度之外,还有我们发现有希望探讨的相关方向(App.D中的限制)。

blocks.en: A.1 Architecture and Representations
blocks.zh: A.1 结构和代表

blocks.en:
Pretrained architecture and adaptation. PhysWAM builds on the Cosmos 3 Mixture-of-Transformers architecture [ Agarwal et al., 2026 , Liang et al., 2024 ] , based on Qwen3-VL [ Bai et al., 2025 ] .
Within each layer, understanding (text) tokens and generation tokens have separate normalization, query/key/value projections, output projections, and feed-forward parameters, and share one attention operation.
Text queries attend causally to text; generation queries attend bidirectionally to all text, visual, and action tokens of the same example.
Text and generated content therefore interact in every layer rather than through a completed prediction passed from one model to another.
All RGB and depth tokens, including the clean RGB context, use the generation pathway.
We adapt the generation pathway with its input projections, output projections, and embeddings, and keep the text pathway, the Wan video VAE [ Wan et al., 2025 ] , and the depth head of Sec. A.2 fixed.

blocks.en:
The geometric losses differ from the flow-matching losses in units and sparsity, and their raw gradients at the velocity outputs can differ from the flow gradients by orders of magnitude.
Fixed weights would have to follow these magnitudes as training changes them; the balancing of Sec. 3.4 instead recomputes the coefficients on every update from the gradients themselves.
For target fractions η k \eta_{k} , each active geometric term contributes an η k \eta_{k} fraction of the action flow-gradient norm at the action output, and a gain γ \gamma on CPP’s depth branch imposes the analogous ratio at the depth output; all gradients are measured before scaling, sg \operatorname{sg} holds the coefficients fixed during backpropagation, and zero-denominator ratios are set to zero.

blocks.en:
Joint denoising and decoding. At inference, all generated representations are initialized independently from Gaussian noise and denoised jointly with the UniPC sampler [ Zhao et al., 2023 ] of the pretrained framework [ Agarwal et al., 2026 ] .
Current RGB, motion history, and text stay fixed at every model evaluation, and the padding channels of the action stream stay zero.
The VAE decoder 𝒟 \mathcal{D} reconstructs RGB and depth at full resolution; averaging the decoded depth channels and applying Eq. ( 10 ) gives metric depth.
The depth head Π ϕ \Pi_{\phi} provides geometric supervision during training only and is not used at inference.

blocks.en: Appendix B Data and Labels
blocks.zh: 附录B 数据和标签

blocks.en:
PhysWAM is trained on recorded driving logs.
Every supervision signal is derived from the sensors, calibration, poses, object annotations, and maps that the logs already contain without any additional manual annotation.
This appendix describes the training windows (Sec. B.1 ), the dense metric depth labels of the depth streams (Sec. B.2 ), the LiDAR targets of CPP (Sec. B.3 ), and the obstacle and drivable-area labels of the hinge losses (Sec. B.4 ).
All geometric labels of a window are expressed in 𝒞 0 \mathcal{C}_{0} , the front-camera frame at the current time, using the recorded poses, so that generated depth, generated motion, and every label share one frame.
blocks.zh:
PhysWAM接受有关记录的驾驶记录的培训.
每个监督信号都来自传感器,校准,姿势,对象说明,以及日志已经包含的地图,没有附加任何人工注释.
本附录描述训练窗口(Sec.B.1),深度流的密集度度量深度标签(Sec.B.2),CPP的LiDAR目标(Sec.B.3),以及链条损失的障碍和可驾驶区标签(Sec.B.4).
一个窗口的所有几何标签都用C 0\ mathcal{C}_{0}表示,当前前相机帧,使用记录的姿势,从而产生深度,生成运动,每个标签共享一个帧.

blocks.en: B.1 Source Data and Training Windows
blocks.zh: B.1 原始数据和培训窗口

blocks.en:
Logs and split. We use the navtrain split of NAVSIM [ Dauner et al., 2024 ] , built on OpenScene [ Contributors, 2023 ] and nuPlan [ Caesar et al., 2021 ] : 1,192 logs recorded at 2 Hz.
Each log frame provides eight camera images, one merged LiDAR sweep, the ego pose, the driving command, and oriented 3D boxes with track identities for all annotated objects.
We use the three forward-facing cameras: front, front-left, and front-right.
Camera intrinsics, Brown lens distortion, and camera-to-LiDAR extrinsics are constant per vehicle and differ between vehicles; images are used as recorded, without undistortion, and every projection in the pipeline uses the vehicle’s own model.
blocks.zh:
日志和分裂。 我们使用NAVSIM [Dauner等人, 2024] 的航海分裂, 建造于 OpenScene [Contritors, 2023] 和 nuPlan [Caesar等人, 2021]: 1,192 日志记录在 2 Hz.
每个日志框提供8个相机图像,1个合并的LiDAR扫描,自负姿势,驱动指令,以及所有注释对象有轨迹身份的定向3D盒.
我们使用三台前视摄像头:前视摄像头,左前视摄像头,右前视摄像头.
相机内在,棕色镜头扭曲,以及相机对LiDAR外观每辆车都是恒定的,不同车辆之间也有所不同;图像被作为记录使用,没有分解,管道中的每一投影都使用车辆自己的模型.

blocks.en:
Windows. One training window is formed at every navtrain scene token: the current frame, the eight following frames ( T = 8 T=8 , 4 s), and the preceding frame, which supplies the motion-history row 𝐚 0 \mathbf{a}_{0} .
A total of 103,281 windows are used for training.
Consecutive tokens of a log are mostly one frame apart, so windows overlap heavily; no command-based filtering or resampling is applied.
The front view is used at 832 × 468 832\times 468 and the side views at 416 × 234 416\times 234 .
blocks.zh:
视窗. 每个导航场景符号都形成一个训练窗口:当前帧,以下8个帧(T=8 T=8,4 s),以及前一个帧,它为运动-历史行提供了0\mathbf{a}_{0}.
共有103,281个窗户用于培训。
一个日志的连续符号多为一个框架相隔,因此窗口重叠严重;没有应用基于命令的过滤或复刻.
前视图使用时间为832×468 832\时468,副视图使用时间为416×234 416\时234 .

blocks.en:
Motion and text. The pose of the front camera at each frame is the composition of the recorded ego pose with the camera extrinsics.
The relative motion 𝚫 t \bm{\Delta}_{t} of Sec. 3.1 is the pose of frame t t expressed in the front-camera frame of frame t − 1 t-1 , stored as translation in metres and the first two columns of the rotation matrix.
The text context is a fixed template that names the city, the discrete driving command (turn left, go straight, turn right, or follow the route), and the current speed; it is replaced by the empty string in 10% of training examples to support classifier-free guidance.
blocks.zh:
动与文. 每帧前置相机的姿势是记录的自负姿势与相机外置相机的构成.
sec.3.1的相对运动式为  t \bm\Delta}_{t}是帧 t t 在帧 − 1 t-1 前相机框中表达的帧 t 的姿势,以公尺和旋转矩阵的前两列形式保存.
文本上下文是一个固定模板,它命名城市,离散驱动命令(左转,直走,右转,或遵循路径),以及当前速度;它被10%的培训示例中的空字符串所取代,以支持无分类器的引导.

blocks.en: B.2 Dense Metric Depth Labels
blocks.zh: B.2 传感器深度标签

blocks.en:
The depth streams are generated modalities and are supervised through the flow-matching loss like RGB, which requires a dense depth video for every view and frame.
LiDAR alone is too sparse for this purpose, so the labels are metric depth predictions of a feed-forward reconstruction model anchored to the LiDAR sweep of each frame.
The labels serve the flow-matching loss only; CPP compares generated depth with the LiDAR itself (Sec. B.3 ).
blocks.zh:
深度流是生成模式,通过RGB这样的流量匹配损失来监督,这需要每个视图和帧的密集深度视频.
光是LiDAR对于这个目的太稀疏了,所以标签是每个帧的LiDAR扫荡所锚定的向导重建模型的度量深度预测.
标签仅服务于流量匹配损失;CPP将生成的深度与LiDAR本身(Sec. B.3 )进行比较.

blocks.en:
Reconstruction with a LiDAR prior. For each frame of a window, MapAnything [ Keetha et al., 2026 ] is run once on the three views jointly, with metric scale enabled and given the calibrated camera poses and the frame’s LiDAR sweep projected into each view as a sparse metric depth prior.
The predicted metric depth and validity mask are resampled to the image grid of Sec. B.1 , so that the depth label, the LiDAR targets, and the calibrated rays share one pixel grid.
Sky pixels are identified by the sky probability of Depth Anything 3 [ Lin et al., 2025 ] and set to d max d_{\max} .
blocks.zh:
用LiDAR进行重建 MapAnything [Keetha等人,2026年]在三面视图上联合运行一次,
预测的度量深度和有效性遮罩被重印到Sec. B.1的图像网格上,这样深度标签,LiDAR目标,校准射线共享一个像素网格.
天空像素由深度 Anything 3 [Lin等人, 2025] 的天空概率来识别,并设定为 d 最大 d_{\max}.

blocks.en:
Hole filling. MapAnything leaves about one fifth of the non-sky pixels of a frame invalid, concentrated in the band around the horizon.
Structure for these holes is taken from the monocular metric prediction of Depth Anything 3 [ Lin et al., 2025 ] on the same frames, scaled to the LiDAR once per window.
Rather than directly use this prediction, we correct it towards the label.
Where both are valid, we compute the log-ratio between the label and the monocular depth; inside a hole, this ratio is interpolated smoothly from the surrounding valid pixels, as the solution of Laplace’s equation [ Pérez et al., 2023 ] with those pixels as boundary values, and the fill is the monocular depth scaled by the interpolated ratio.
Holes that the monocular model also leaves unstructured are filled by interpolating the label’s own log depth in the same way, and are assigned d max d_{\max} only where the interpolated depth exceeds 40 m.
On the front view, 65% of the pixels of the final label come from MapAnything, 16% from the corrected fill, 15% are sky, and 4% are smooth extensions; the two side views are similar.
blocks.zh:
洞满. Map Anything留下了约五分之一的帧无效的非天空像素,集中在地平线周围的乐队.
这些孔的结构取自在同一帧上对深度Anything 3[Lin等人,2025年]的单光度度量预测,每扇窗一次缩放到LiDAR.
我们不是直接使用这种预测,而是将其改正为标签。
在两者都有效的地方,我们计算标签和单倍深度之间的对数比;在一个孔内,这个比值从周围的有效像素中顺利地插入,作为Laplace方程[Pérez等人,2023年]的解法,这些像素作为边界值,填充就是由插倍比缩放的单倍深度.
单体模型也留下无结构的洞通过同样方式插入标签本身的日志深度来填充,并且只有在插入深度超过40米时才被分配到 d max 。
在前视图中,最终标签65%的像素来自MapAnything,16%来自修正的填充,15%是天空,4%是平滑扩展;两个侧视图相似.

blocks.en:
Bias correction. Compared with the LiDAR, MapAnything reads about 3% far at 10–25 m and 5% near at 60–80 m, a bias that is a function of depth alone and is consistent across vehicles.
We fit a piecewise-linear correction of log depth, with the range from 2 m to 80 m partitioned into ten segments, on 34.6 M label–LiDAR pixel pairs from all sixteen vehicles, keeping 30% of the driving logs aside to check the fit, and apply it to every label before encoding.
After correction, the median log-ratio between label and LiDAR is within 0.023 0.023 in every depth band.
blocks.zh:
偏见修正。 与LiDAR相比,MapAnything在10–25米和60–80米附近读得相距约3%,这种偏差仅是深度的函数,而且各车辆之间是一致的。
在34.6 M 标签上-LiDAR像素对全部16辆车辆进行分解, 将30%的驾驶记录留作检查, 在编码前应用到每个标签上。
在修正后,标签和LiDAR之间的中位数对数比例在每个深度波段在0.023 0.023以内.

blocks.en: Encoding. The corrected label is clipped to [ d min , d max ] = [ 0.5 , 80 ] [d_{\min},d_{\max}]=[0.5,80] m, encoded by Eq. ( 9 ), and stored as an 8-bit video at the resolution of the RGB stream; the 255 levels span the log-depth range in steps of about 1.6% relative depth.
blocks.zh: 编码. 校正后的标签被剪切为[dmin,d max]=[0.5,80] [d_{\min},d_{\max]=[0.5,80] m,由Eq. (9)编码,并作为8位视频存储在RGB流的分辨率上;255关跨日志深度范围,相对深度约为1.6%.

blocks.en:
Verification. Table 5 compares the final labels with the raw LiDAR on 1,000 windows covering all sixteen vehicles, using a projection of the sweeps written independently of the label pipeline.
Agreement is measured on the LiDAR-supported latent cells that CPP uses and on all pixels with a LiDAR return within 25 m; the front–side seam is checked on the columns where the views overlap.
blocks.zh:
核查。 表5将最终标签与覆盖所有16辆车的1000个窗口上的原始LiDAR进行比较,使用独立于标签管道的扫描投影.
在CPP 使用的LiDAR 支持的潜在细胞和所有带LiDAR 返回的像素上测量一致;在视图重叠的柱子上检查前侧接合。

blocks.en: Table 5: Depth-label quality against LiDAR on 1,000 training windows. AbsRel is the mean absolute relative depth error; the cell-level column uses the geometric-mean LiDAR depth of latent cells with at least three returns, the pixel-level column all LiDAR returns within 25 m. Sky error is the fraction of pixels labelled sky that carry a LiDAR return.
blocks.zh: 表5:1000个培训窗口的深度标签质量与LiDAR对比. AbsRel是平均绝对相对深度误差;单元格级列使用潜伏细胞的几何-平均值LiDAR深度,至少三个返回,像素级列所有LiDAR在25米范围内返回. 天空错误是带有LiDAR返回的标记天空的像素碎片.

blocks.en: B.3 LiDAR Targets
blocks.zh: B.3 LiDAR 目标

blocks.en:
Projection. For every frame of a window and every view, the frame’s LiDAR sweep is projected into the camera through the vehicle’s own model.
Returns on the ego vehicle are removed, the remainder are transformed into the camera frame and restricted to optical-axis depths in [ 0.3 , 80 ] [0.3,80] m, and points outside the lens field of view are discarded before distortion is applied.
Each surviving return is assigned to the pixel containing its projection, and where several returns land on one pixel the nearest is kept.
blocks.zh:
预测。 每一扇窗框和每一幅视图,都通过车辆本身的型号投射到镜头中。
自我飞行器上的返回被移除,其余部分被转换成相机框,并限制在[0.3,80] [0.3,80]米的光学轴深,镜头视野外的点被丢弃,然后进行扭曲.
每个幸存的返回被分配到包含其投影的像素上,在一个像素上数个返回的陆地上,保存最接近的.

blocks.en:
Pooling. The projected returns are pooled onto the latent grid of Sec. A.1 , whose 16 × 16 16\times 16 -pixel cells coincide with the cells of the VAE.
For each cell we store the number of returns and the mean of their log depths; the CPP target d t L , v ​ ( u ) d_{t}^{L,v}(u) of Eq. ( 6 ) is the exponential of the latter, the geometric-mean depth, and a cell is a valid correspondence when it holds at least n min = 3 n_{\min}=3 returns.
Cells on moving objects are retained: at each anchor, generated and measured geometry describe the same instant, so the comparison is valid for dynamic and static structure alike.
The same pooled targets serve to fit the depth head of Sec. A.2 .
blocks.zh:
池冲. 预测的回报被集合到Sec. A.1的潜在网格上,其16×16 16\times 16-像素细胞与VAE的细胞重合.
对于每个单元格,我们存储返回的数量及其日志深度的平均值;CPP目标d t L, v (u) d_{t}^{L,v} Eq (6) (u) 是后者的指数,几何-平均值深度,一个单元格当它持有至少n min = 3 n_{\min}=3 返回时,是一个有效的对应.
移动对象上的单元格被保留:在每个锚地上,生成和测量几何描述同一个瞬间,因此比较对动态和静态结构都是有效的.
同样的集合目标符合Sec.A.2的深度头部。

blocks.en:
Poses and rays. The recorded poses 𝐓 t ⋆ \mathbf{T}^{\star}_{t} are the front-camera poses of Sec. B.1 expressed in 𝒞 0 \mathcal{C}_{0} , and equal the composition of the recorded motion rows.
The calibrated rays of Sec. A.1 are obtained by inverting the vehicle’s distortion model at every cell and patch centre.
blocks.zh:
针锋相对 被记录的姿势为 T t \ mathbf{T}^{\star}_{t} 是 Sec. B.1 的前相机姿势,以 C 0\ mathcal{C}_{0} 表示, 并等于被记录的运动行的构成.
Sec. A.1的校准射线是通过在每个牢房和补丁中心颠倒车辆的失真模型获得的。

blocks.en: B.4 Obstacle and Drivable-Area Labels
blocks.zh: B.4 障碍和可移动地区标签

blocks.en:
Obstacle sets. For each future frame t = 1 , … , T t=1,\ldots,T , the box set 𝒪 t \mathcal{O}_{t} of Sec. A.3 contains all annotated objects within 40 m of the ego vehicle at t t , of every class, as oriented rectangles in the ground plane of 𝒞 0 \mathcal{C}_{0} .
The static set 𝒮 t \mathcal{S}_{t} is built from the sweep recorded at t t : returns on the ego vehicle and inside any annotated box, dilated by 0.3 m, are removed; the remainder are restricted to heights between 0.3 m and 3 m above the local ground, estimated from the lowest returns near the vehicle, and to planar distances between 1 m and 25 m from the ego position at t t .
Isolated returns are suppressed by keeping only 0.5 0.5 m ground-plane columns with at least two returns, each represented by its return nearest to the recorded waypoint, and the set is limited to the 2,048 points nearest to that waypoint, so the return that determines the recorded clearance is always among them.
The recorded clearance d t ⋆ d^{\star}_{t} is evaluated from these sets at the recorded waypoint.
blocks.zh:
障碍装置。 对于每个未来的帧 t = 1, ..., T = 1,\ ldots, T, 框集 O t\ mathcal{ O}_{t} sec. A.3 包含了在每类 t t 的自负飞行器40米范围内的所有附加注释的物体, 作为 C 0\ mathcal{ C}_{0} 的地面平面上的定向矩形.
静态设定 S t \ mathcal{S}_{t} 建于 t t 记录的扫荡中: 自负车和任何附加说明的箱内返回, 放大0. 3 m; 其余限制于当地地面上0. 3 m 至 3 m 之间的高度, 从车辆附近最低的返回量估计, 距自负车的位置1 m 到 25 m 之间的平面距离 。
孤立的返回被压制,只保留至少两个返回的0.5米地面飞机纵队,每个纵队的返回以距离记录的航点最近的返回为代表,而该航点的返回仅限于离该航点最近的2 048个航点,因此,决定记录的清除的返回总是其中之一。
在记录的路口从这些设备中评估所记录的清关。

blocks.en:
Drivable-area field. The drivable region 𝒟 \mathcal{D} is the union of the road-block, intersection, and car-park polygons of the nuPlan map within 100 m of the ego vehicle at the current frame, the same layers that the NAVSIM drivable-area metric treats as permissible.
The polygons are rasterized in the ground plane of 𝒞 0 \mathcal{C}_{0} on the 128 × 128 128\times 128 grid of Sec. A.3 with r S = 0.5 r_{S}=0.5 m, covering x ∈ [ − 32 , 32 ) x\in[-32,32) m and z ∈ [ − 8 , 56 ) z\in[-8,56) m, and the signed distance field is computed by Euclidean distance transforms of the rasterized region and its complement.
On 60 held-out windows the rasterized region agrees with the NAVSIM devkit’s own drivable map cell for cell.
blocks.zh:
潜水区 可驾驶区域 D\ mathcal{D} 是当前框架下自负飞行器100米范围内的nuPlan地图的路障、交汇点和车 Park多边形的结合,与NAVSIM可驾驶区域度量衡认为允许的层次相同。
多边形在128×128 128\times 128 sec的地面平面上被光栅化. A.3带r S = 0.5 r r _{ S}= 0.5 m,覆盖x ∈ [− 32, 32] x\ in [− 32,32] m 和 z ∈ [− 8, 56] z\in [-8,56] m, 所签名的距离场由光栅化区域的欧几利得距离变换及其补充计算.
在60个被搁置的窗口上,光栅化区域同意NAVSIM devkit自己的可驾驶的单元格。

blocks.en: Coverage. Every training window carries all three cameras on all frames, a LiDAR sweep on the current and future frames, calibration, annotations, and a complete set of labels; windows missing any of these are excluded rather than substituted.
blocks.zh: 覆盖。 每个训练窗口在所有帧上都装有三台相机,对当前和未来帧进行LiDAR扫描,校准,说明,以及一套完整的标签;缺失其中任何一台的窗口都排除在外,而不是替换.

blocks.en: Appendix C Experimental Details and Additional Results
blocks.zh: 附录C 细节和其他结果

blocks.en: C.1 Hyperparameters and Metrics
blocks.zh: C.1 超参数和计量

blocks.en:
PhysWAM is obtained by full fine-tuning of the generation pathway of Cosmos 3 Nano on the NAVSIM navtrain windows of App. B , with the understanding pathway, the VAE, and the depth head fixed.
Every update minimizes the objective of Eq. ( 8 ): flow matching on the three RGB streams, the three depth streams, and the ego-motion rows, with the CPP and hinge terms scaled to a fixed fraction of the action flow-gradient norm.
The hinge fractions are annealed to zero during the first half of training and CPP stays active throughout, so the geometric supervision that remains at the end is the one the model carries into planning.
One model, evaluated with an exponential moving average of its weights, produces every PhysWAM result of Sec. 4.1 , and Table 6 lists its settings. The rows marked “without CPP” come from the same recipe with the CPP term removed (Sec. 4.2 ).
blocks.zh:

每一次更新都会最小化Eq. (8):在三个RGB流,三个深度流,和自我运动行上的流量匹配,与CPP和链条条件缩放到动作流度规范的固定部分.

blocks.en:
Hinge schedule. Both hinges are one-sided and vanish on every plan that keeps its margins, and the obstacle margin is capped at the recorded clearance (Sec. 3.4 ), so the recorded trajectory incurs no obstacle loss.
Early in training many plans violate the margins, and the hinges give a direct gradient on waypoint positions.
Late in training few plans do, yet the balancing of Sec. 3.4 still scales each active term to a fixed fraction of the action flow-gradient norm, which would concentrate that fraction on the few remaining plans.
We therefore anneal both hinges to zero by the middle of training.
CPP penalizes deviation in either direction on every LiDAR-supported cell, so it does not vanish once plans are safe.

在培训初期,许多计划都违反了边际关系,而链条则给路标位置带来直接的梯度.
在培训后期,很少有计划这样做,然而,第3.4节的平衡仍然将每个活跃期缩减为行动流动升级规范的固定部分,这将使该部分集中在少数剩余的计划中。
因此,在训练中途,我们两人均处于零下。
CPP惩罚每个LiDAR支持的单元格方向的偏差,因此它不会在计划安全后消失.

blocks.en: Appendix D Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录D 限制

blocks.en:
Supervision. CPP compares generated geometry with LiDAR sweeps carried by the recorded poses, so training needs a LiDAR sensor calibrated to the cameras and an accurate ego trajectory.
The depth streams need dense metric labels, which we obtain from a reconstruction model anchored to the same LiDAR (App. B.2 ), and the hinges need obstacle and drivable-area labels (App. B.4 ).
Every term of the objective is therefore tied to an instrumented collection platform.
Scaling to the far larger body of driving video recorded without LiDAR would need a self-supervised form of the coupling, for instance between generated depth and generated motion alone, which we have not developed.
blocks.zh:
监管. CPP将生成的几何学与被录制的姿势所携带的LiDAR扫描比较,因此训练需要将LiDAR传感器校准到相机上,并精确的自我轨迹.
深度流需要密集的度量标标签,我们从一个基于同一LiDAR(App. B.2 )的重建模型中获取,而链条需要障碍和可驾驶区域标签(App. B.4 ).
因此,目标的每个期限都与仪器收集平台挂钩。
在没有LiDAR的驾驶录影带中, 需要一种自我监督的结合方式, 例如, 产生深度与产生运动之间,

blocks.en:
Consistency against the recorded future only. CPP enforces agreement between generated depth and motion where LiDAR supports the recorded trajectory.
Self-consistency away from that trajectory, under counterfactual commands or beyond the 4 s window, is measured only indirectly (App. C.5 ) and is not supervised, and whether the coupling generalizes there is open.
blocks.zh:
只与记录的未来保持一致。 CPP执行生成深度与运动之间的协议,其中LiDAR支持记录的轨迹.
远离该轨迹的自我一致性,在反事实命令下或4s窗口之外,只能间接测量(App.C.5),不受监督,耦合一般是否开放.

blocks.en:
One backbone, one scale, one training run per configuration. All results come from Cosmos 3 Nano at one model size, and each training configuration was run once.
We report sample-to-sample variation (Table 1 ) but not run-to-run variation, and we have not studied how the formulation behaves across backbones, model sizes or data scales due to compute constraints.

每个配置一个主干,一个尺度,一个训练. 所有结果均来自Cosmos 3 Nano以一个模型大小,每个训练配置都运行过一次.
我们报告样本到样本的变异(表1),但没有报告运行到运行的变异,我们也没有研究由于计算限制,配方如何在骨干,模型大小或数据尺度之间表现.

blocks.en:
Inference cost. Every plan generates a full multi-view future.
One plan costs 9.4 GPU-seconds at 30 sampler steps and 4.4 at 8 (App. C.6 ), the medoid rule multiplies this by the number of samples, and an action-only inference path was not tested; the closed-loop evaluation replans in simulation time and does not establish real-time operation.

blocks.en:
Generative driving world models. Driving world models learn controllable future-video generation from driving data [ Wang et al., 2024c , Hu et al., 2023a , Gao et al., 2024b ] , with GAIA-2 supporting coordinated generation across multiple cameras [ Russell et al., 2025 ] .
Other representations make scene structure explicit: MUVO predicts images, LiDAR, and occupancy [ Bogdoll et al., 2025 ] , while OccWorld jointly forecasts occupancy and ego motion [ Zheng et al., 2024 ] .
OmniNWM further combines panoramic video with depth, semantics, and occupancy [ Li et al., 2025a ] .
These approaches establish the value of modeling the future beyond appearance (RGB video) alone. PhysWAM combines multiview video and metric depth with ego-motion generation in a shared flow-matching model, providing explicit scene geometry alongside the generated action.
blocks.zh:
基因驱动世界模型. 驱动世界模型从驱动数据中学习可控的未来-视频生成[Wang等人,2024c,Hu等人,2023a,Gao等人,2024b],GAIA-2支持跨多个相机的协调生成[Russell等人,2025].
其他表述则明确了场景结构:MUVO预测图像,LiDAR,和占用[Bogdol等人,2025年],而OccWorld联合预测占用和自我运动[郑等人,2024年].
OmniNWM进一步结合了全景视频与深度,语义,和占用[李等人,2025a].
这些方法确定了模拟未来超越外观的价值(RGB视频). PhysWAM将多景视频和度量深度与自我动作生成结合到一个共享的流量匹配模型中,与生成的动作一起提供清晰的场景几何.

blocks.en:
World-action models (WAMs) and planning. Future prediction can improve policy representations through auxiliary visual or latent objectives [ Li et al., 2025c , Zhao et al., 2026b ] .
Joint video–action modeling has also been explored in driving [ Zhang et al., 2025b , Liu et al., 2026b ] and robotics [ Zhu et al., 2025 , Ye et al., 2026 ] .
Beyond generation, predicted visual or latent futures support learned trajectory evaluation and policy refinement [ Zheng et al., 2025 , Yang et al., 2026 , Liu et al., 2026a ] .
ExploreVLA uses uncertainty in future predictions to guide safety-aware policy exploration [ Sheng et al., 2026 ] . PhysWAM follows the joint-generation approach while keeping trajectory selection simple: a parameter-free consensus rule uses only pairwise distances among sampled trajectories, without a learned scorer or simulator feedback.
blocks.zh:
世界行动模式和规划。 未来的预测可以通过辅助视觉或潜在目标改进政策表述[李等人,2025c.,赵等人,2026b].
在驾驶方面还探索了联合录像-行动模型[ 张等,2025b;刘等,2026b]和机器人[朱等,2025,叶等,2026].
超越生成,预测的视觉或潜在未来支持所学的轨迹评价和政策完善[郑等人,2025年,杨等人,2026年,刘等人,2026年a].
ExploreVLA利用未来预测中的不确定性指导安全意识政策探索 [ 盛等,2026] (中文(简体) ). PhysWAM遵循联合生成方法,同时保持轨迹选择简单:一个无参数的共识规则只使用抽样轨迹之间的双向距离,没有学习的计分器或模拟器反馈.

blocks.en:
Geometry in world and action generation. View synthesis provides a foundation for jointly learning depth and camera motion through geometric supervision [ Zhou et al., 2017 ] .
In generative models, geometry serves as a conditioning signal, an output, or a training target.
GeoDrive and ReCamDriving use geometry rendered along supplied trajectories to guide video generation [ Chen et al., 2025a , Yaokun et al., 2026 ] .
UniFuture jointly forecasts RGB and depth [ Liang et al., 2025 ] , while X-WAM adds depth prediction to video–action modeling [ Guo et al., 2026 ] .
DriveDreamer-Policy integrates depth, video, and action experts [ Zhou et al., 2026a ] , and GeoWorldAD and GeoWAM use geometric representations to condition planning [ Zhang et al., 2026b , Lu et al., 2026 ] .
Geometry Forcing aligns video-model features with geometric representations [ Wu et al., 2026 ] , while 4D-WAM supervises generated video through depth and features recovered from generated and recorded frames [ Fu et al., 2026 ] via a Geometric Foundation Model [ Wang et al., 2025 , Wang et al., 2026a ] . PhysWAM explicitly includes generated ego motion in its geometric objective.
CPP unprojects generated depth, transforms the resulting geometry using generated motion, and compares it with LiDAR transformed using recorded motion in a shared reference frame.
This shared metric loss promotes physical consistency with the measured scene by supervising both outputs alongside their individual flow-matching objectives.
blocks.zh:
世界几何与动作一代. View合成通过几何监督为联合学习深度和相机运动提供了基础[周等,2017].
在基因模型中,几何作为条件信号,输出,或训练目标.
GeoDrive和ReCamDriving利用所提供的轨迹所提供的几何来指导视频生成[Chen等人,2025a,Yaokun等人,2026].
UniFuture联合预测RGB和深度[Liang等人,2025年],而X-WAM则在视频-动作模型中加入了深度预测[Guo等人,2026年].
DriveDreamer-Policy集深度,视频,动作专家[周等人,2026a],GeoWorldAD和GeoWAM利用几何表示来进行条件规划[张等人,2026b,吕等人,2026].
几何强化法将视频模型特征与几何表达法[Wu等人,2026年]相协调,而4D-WAM通过深度监控生成的视频,并从生成和录制的帧中恢复的特征[Fu等人,2026年]通过几何基础模型[Wang等人,2025年,Wang等人,2026年a]. PhysWAM在其几何目标中明确包括了产生的自我运动.
CPP un project 生成深度,利用生成的运动来改变所生成的几何,并将其与LiDAR在共享参考框中使用录制的运动来进行对比.
这一共同的计量损失通过监督两种产出及其个人流量匹配目标,促进了与所测量场景的物理一致性。
